content: Sọlọmọn ophyem ekkoji

Iwa Sọlọmọn orenga iyok ttara ọvaar Phero kw'Ijip, orenga mẹ ọtzọkha nnwa kwa Phero k'ọbada. Otzim-ẹ okhuna k'Odedenmon kwa Devid maa, okyera ọtzọhm f'ẹvaar-ttọhmma ọmaana Ọhọhm kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ttara ọbaakha kw'ọkhọri Jẹrusalẹm osisi.
Wa anọng mba am-asi njafọhni k'ọjafọhnibe f'ikpokpobha k'ọyaankpa, okhuri da iwa bẹ ani Ọhọhm kwa che ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi atzima asa.
Sọlọmọn ọkhọhkha idadaakha sẹ s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oruk akpen otzor ka ndọhna s'otte Devid ọnang-ẹ, kw'oyongi bi, wa kẹ ọfọhni nja obiro ọkwọmi insẹns k'ọjafọhnibe f'ikpokpobha k'ọyaankpa.

Iwa ọvaarnọng ọm-ọtza ọfọhni nja ka Gibeọn, okhuri bi, kẹ wọ iwa ode ọjafọhnibe f'ikpokpobha f'ọbari odik ọtzam. Wa Sọlọmọn ọnangi nnanga nkwọmisẹ nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh jobh, m'ijafọhnibe nna s'ikpokpobha.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oyin Sọlọmọn abẹ k'erungi k'idachen ka Gibeọn. Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “Kọ phyem ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'arori bi, nnang-ọ.”

Sọlọmọn obhina bi, “Kọ akk'ejibha-barada asa anang otte kwaam Devid, kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kwọ, okhuri da iwa kẹ ophe nnam ka kọ, obiro otzor-otzor, ọkhaama ettem ọkkakka. Kọ achin ororo asi ejibha-barada nda anang-ẹ, anang-ẹ nnwa kw'ijinọng bi, ọtzọkha ẹvaar chẹ maa, pyiri ma.

“Manya, o Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwaam, kọ akk'kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ, ọvaarnọng asa bi, ndera eho ch'otte kwaam Devid. Yina, kaam ndimi nde nnwa-nnwa, kaam odem kwa nsi itzọhmbọhk saam kinnọng.
Kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ nwobh k'ottem kw'anọng p'akk'atzekha, anọng-barada, p'ahaabhi ayọhnga odem kw'ọnọng ofha obhik.
Mẹ wọ, nang kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ ekkoji k'ettem cha ndima ndabh anọng pọ. Mbiri mfha ndima chẹ ngọhkha odengọmi kw'odik kw'otzor-otzor ttara epina. Ọnọng kw'ọfha ọdabh anọng-barada mba pọ kode e.”
Iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọdaam ettem ttara Sọlọmọn bi, okk'odik nwa ophyema.
Mando kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben-ẹ bi, “Mada kọ akhiri akpen p'adumi eden, ọmaana ikkọ, ttara obo kw'attattaanga-nọng pọ aji, an-aphyem, ekkoji ch'atzima asi eponga-ttọhna ẹkkakka,
kaam ńnang-ọ f'aphyemi ọnang. Kaam ńnang-ọ ettem ch'ekkoji ọmaana ch'eronga maa, ọnọng kode kw'iwa ọkk'ọda mach-ọ, ọnọng kóbiro ode kw'óde mach-ọ.
Ayongi mẹ, kaam ńnang-ọ f'an-aphyemi, ikkọ ọmaana abarada, ifha k'akpen pọ biphyir, ọvaarnọng kw'obeng-ọ abẹ, kóde.
Idikha kọ ahak eho anang-m, abira ahok aphaangi ọmaana asana paam mach'iwa atte Devid ohokhi, kaam ńnang-ọ akpen p'adum-odum.”

Sọlọmọn ogbe ọphyọbha, on-oronga bi, kkeri idachen nọ. Ọkpa nnam ka Jẹrusalẹm, ọtza obe k'itzitzikha s'Ẹkkọhbhi ch'Echekhi ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, osi njafọhni sa nnanga nkwọmisẹ, ọmaana sa nnanga s'odidiri. On-osi ọdadaami ọnang atzọhmnọng pẹ biphyir.
Sọlọmọn ọkhọhk ekkoji chẹ
Iwa azaaza afa akwu ayin abe ọvaarnọng k'itzitzikha.
Oyok wani oben bi, “Itta kwaam tzotzokhaan, kwanọng nwa ọmaana kaam morukhi k'ọhọhm wani. Kaam mmaani nnwa k'ogbe kw'owobh m'ọhọhm ttar-m.
Okwu opyiri iwu ittaan sa mmaani nnwa kwaam, kwanọng nwa obiro ọmaan nnwa. Man anọng afa bẹ-bẹ bọ owobh k'ọhọhm, ọnọng ọdọdọk kw'owobh mẹ ttara man kode.
“Kwanọng nwa oyim k'erungi ọkpẹkhi nnwa, nnwa kwẹ ope.
Mando kw'ọphyọbh k'erungi, otzini nnwa kwaam kw'oyim-m k'ẹbhabhaanga, k'ogbe kwa mmintaabha ọda. Ọtzọkha nnwa kwaam oruri k'ẹba, ọtzọkha nnwa-bukhi kwẹ orur-m m'ẹbaa.
Mada ewu ehobh, mbina bi nnọk nnwa kwaam, nna nne bi, ọkk'ọpa. Mada nna ndẹ-ẹ otzum nge k'ekpebha, nne bi, nnwa kwaam kwa mmaani arang mẹ.”

Kwanọng nwonggo oben bi, “Mma! Oyok kw'orukhi akpen wọ ode kwaam, obukhi ode kwọ.” Yina, ocheden-kwanọng ochina ororo oben bi, “Mma e! Obukhi ode kwọ, kw'orukhi akpen ode kwaam e.” Mẹ wọ, bẹ asi ikhakhaanga m'itzitzikha s'ọvaarnọng.
Ọvaarnọng oben bi, “Oyok nwa obi, ‘Kw'orukhi akpen ode kwaam, obukhi ode kwọ.’ Oyok nwonggo bi, ‘Mma! Obukhi ode kwọ, kw'orukhi akpen ode kwaam.’ ”
Mando kw'ọvaarnọng obeni bi, “Bọng nang-m ọkkangkkaang.” Mẹ wọ, bẹ atzọkha ọkkangkkaang achena ọvaarnọng.
Ọvaarnọng ọn-ọnang ẹfa bi: “Bẹ akkema nnwa kw'orukhi akpen agbokha afa, atzọkha igbokha anang oyok wani, bẹ abira atzọkha igbokha anang oyok nwonggo.”

Kwanọng kw'ọkhaam nnwa kw'orukhi akpen, orenga k'idadaakha s'ọkhaam ttara nnwa kwẹ abẹbẹ, okhukhi ọvaarnọng oben bi, “Itta kwaam, tzotzokhaan, nang-ẹ nnwa kw'orukhi akpen! Kẹ kafhu!” Yina, kwanọng nwonggo oben bi, “Ọnọng kw'ọ́khaam-ẹ k'ottem kwa man anọng afa kode. Kkem-ẹ k'obe ọfa!”
Mando kw'ọvaarnọng ọkpaar aponga, oben bi: “Bọng nang ocheden-kwanọng nnwa kw'orukhi akpen. Bọng kẹ kàfhu, kkeri kẹ wọ ode ọkka.”
K'ogbe kw'anọng p'Israẹl biphyir an-abhaang eponga-ttọhna ch'ọvaarnọng ọkk'ọnanga, ọvaarnọng on-ojora bẹ, okhuri da be are bi, kẹ ọtzọk ekkoji k'Ibinọkpaabyi, otzima osi aponga p'atzor-otzor.
